breakdown.description: The prompt uses rpm directly as angular velocity in P = T ω, even though ω must be in radians per second.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory and incorrect instruction to use rpm directly as the angular velocity ω. The generated specification correctly ignores this incorrect instruction and instead includes the proper formula for calculating angular velocity in radians per second: ω = 2π(rpm/60). This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
